hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && python3 production/coherence/coherence.py check 2>&1 | sed 's/^/[coherence] /' || true

_comment: Stop hooks fire at the end of every assistant turn. (1) coherence check: detects stale artifacts. (2) dashboard regen: updates production/dashboard/index.html. Both are non-blocking (|| true). To disable, remove the entry. Manual triggers: `python3 production/coherence/coherence.py check` and `python3 production/dashboard/generate.py`.
